name: Zegon
description: Ashnod's home city and a focus of Mishra's efforts.

description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War (article)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Zegon, Mishra meets Ashnod, who shows him the Staff of Zegon, and he takes her as apprentice.
timeline.quote: enough to take her on as an apprentice

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod sneaks into Mishra's camp to negotiate for Zegon and becomes his apprentice and lover; Zegon submits to the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra, his interest piqued, studied the staff, and they agreed she would become his apprentice. They also became lovers.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Both brothers court Ashnod and suffer a final cataclysmic quarrel, parting forever.
timeline.quote: they had a final cataclysmic quarrel and parted ways forever.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nearly all Fallaji die in the Last Battle and the empire collapses; Tomakul and Zegon are ruined.
timeline.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle, and the empire collapsed after the war.
